what_it_does: «thedotmack/claude-mem» یک پروژه در حوزه AI است. توضیح ثبت‌شده: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More زبان: JavaScript. موضوعات مرتبط: ai، ai-agents، ai-memory، anthropic، artificial-intelligence، chromadb.
